w10_T4_002096: Petra had 111 chocolates in a box for the office and found 5 more loose in her bag. Her colleague Denis, who had brought none of his own, handed 79 of them round at the morning meeting. Another 34 went out with the afternoon tea. Petra ate 2 herself before going home. How many chocolates are left in the box?
w10_T4_002101: A stationery shop received 187 boxes of pens, and each box held 4 pens. A supplier added 51 loose pens to the same drawer. A school then bought 276 pens for the new term. A college took another 404 pens for its own students. The shop has traded on this corner for a dozen years. How many pens are left in the drawer?
w10_T4_002102: A festival box office had already sold 149 tickets when it opened on Friday morning. Another 72 went before lunch, and the early afternoon brought 57 more. Later that afternoon a coach party took 50 tickets, and the evening queue added 55. A rained-off group then returned 72 tickets for a refund. The box office quotes its waiting times in minutes rather than hours. How many tickets have been sold in total?
w10_T4_002104: On Saturday morning Ines had 130 punnets at her fruit stall and a grower delivered 76 more. Before lunch her partner Kwame, who had brought fewer punnets than Ines, added 72 from his van. During the afternoon 49 punnets were sold to shoppers. In the evening the pair counted what was left and confirmed that each punnet holds 9 plums. The following week the stall handled 2 times that number of plums. The market charges 35 pounds for a pitch. How many plums did the stall handle the following week?
w10_T4_002107: A garden club shared 140 seed trays equally between 4 plots. Every tray in the first plot was planted with 3 rows. Each row grew 7 lettuces. Slugs then destroyed 49 of the lettuces in that plot. The club sold 489 lettuces from it at the summer sale. The club has been meeting for a dozen years. How many lettuces are left in the first plot?
w10_T4_002109: A depot had 237 crates and sent 28 of them back as damaged. Every crate still in the depot holds 4 boxes. A courier added 40 loose boxes of exactly the same kind. Each box contains 7 tubes of glue. The depot records its shift lengths in minutes rather than hours. How many tubes of glue are in the depot?
w10_T4_002115: A school received 100 boxes of exercise books and sent half of them to the junior building. Of the boxes that stayed, 31 were opened and used at once. Every unopened box still in the store holds 7 books. The office then found 13 loose books in a cupboard and added them to the store. The store has not been tidied since the summer. How many books are in the store now?
w10_T4_002119: A brewery has 237 barrels in the cellar and 57 more standing out in the yard. Every barrel is decanted into 4 kegs. A supplier then delivered 44 ready-filled kegs of the same size. Each keg fills 9 crates of bottles. The brewery's chimney is 22 metres tall. How many crates of bottles can the brewery fill?
w10_T4_002120: On Monday morning a wholesaler had 227 sacks of rice and sold 76 of them before ten. A forklift split 1 sack open, and it was written off. In the afternoon half of the remaining sacks were sent to the northern branch and the other half stayed on site. Every sack still on site holds 6 bags of rice. In the evening a delivery added 49 loose bags to the store. The warehouse floor is 90 metres wide. How many bags of rice are on site?
w10_T4_002122: On Friday morning Lucia counted 214 boxes of tiles at the depot. Before lunch a delivery added 19 boxes. In the afternoon her colleague Marek, who had ordered fewer boxes than Lucia, brought 32 over from his own store. That evening a returned pallet added 79 more. Every box in the depot holds 3 tiles. The depot's roller door is 5 metres high. How many tiles are in the depot?
w10_T4_002127: A charity split 214 boxes of clothes equally between 2 warehouses. Every box in the first warehouse holds 4 coats. A donor added 38 loose coats to that warehouse. A shelter then collected 172 coats from it. Maria, who runs the first warehouse, had each remaining coat packed with 4 hangers, while her colleague Josef handled far fewer coats at the second site. How many hangers does the first warehouse need?
w10_T4_002136: A nursery filled 72 trays, and each tray held 9 seedlings. A grower delivered 73 loose seedlings, and a school donated 45 more. A landscaping contract then took 703 seedlings away. Frost killed another 34 of the seedlings still on the bench. The nursery has been trading for a dozen years. How many seedlings are left on the bench?
w10_T4_002146: Ronan had 115 sheets of plywood and used 94 of them on the stage set. Every sheet left in the workshop can be cut into 5 panels. His colleague Beata, who had fewer sheets than Ronan to begin with, contributed 71 panels she had already cut. Each panel takes 8 screws to fix in place. A box was dropped and 87 of the screws were lost down a drain. The theatre seats 320 people. How many screws are available for the job?
w10_T4_002151: A ticket office had sold 225 seats for the gala by Monday morning. Before lunch 52 more went, and the early afternoon added 41. A coach company then cancelled and returned 223 seats. That evening 41 seats were sold at the door. On Tuesday morning another 29 went, and on Tuesday evening a further 29. The office quotes its queue times in minutes rather than hours. How many seats have been sold in total?
w10_T4_002157: A club had 134 folding chairs and bought 9 more at auction. A school borrowed 64 of them for a play. A member returned 5 chairs that had been sitting in her garage. The chairs were then shared equally between 3 halls, and the village hall took the first share. Then 3 of that hall's chairs were broken during a ceilidh, and a wedding party took another 24 away. The hall records its bookings in minutes rather than hours. How many chairs are left in the village hall?
w10_T4_002165: A cheesemaker had 91 rounds of cheese in the store and bought 14 more from a neighbour. A wholesaler took 85 rounds away on Tuesday. Every round still in the store is cut into 6 wedges. A market stall returned 25 unsold wedges, and 11 wedges were found to have spoiled. A late order then added 49 fresh wedges to the counter. The dairy milks 40 cows and has done so for a dozen years. How many wedges does the cheesemaker have?
w10_T4_002169: A soap workshop poured 56 moulds, and each mould set into 6 bars. A gift shop bought 218 bars for its Christmas stock. A returned order brought 58 bars back to the workshop, and a new batch added 64 more. A hotel then took 226 bars for its rooms. The workshop has been making soap for a dozen years. How many bars are left?
w10_T4_002170: Anita had 117 lengths of wire in her shed and bought 22 more at the market. She used 87 lengths making frames for the show. Every length still in the shed can be cut into 3 hooks. Her friend Dev, who had far fewer lengths than Anita, took 109 of the hooks for his own stall. Each hook Anita kept is dipped in 8 drops of enamel. The pair have exhibited together for a dozen years. How many drops of enamel does Anita need?
w10_T4_002171: On Wednesday morning Tomas had 107 boxes of nails in his van and left 53 of them at the first site. Before lunch he dropped 21 more boxes at a second site. In the afternoon his colleague Freya, who carries fewer boxes than Tomas, loaded 57 boxes into his van from the depot. That evening he checked and confirmed that every box in the van holds 8 packets. How many packets of nails are in the van?
w10_T4_002172: A shop had 31 gift boxes on the shelf and sold 28 of them before the holiday. Then 2 more were taken for the window display. Every box still on the shelf contains 7 candles. A supplier delivered 54 loose candles to the same shelf. The shop has been open for a dozen years and lists its opening times in minutes past the hour rather than in hours. How many candles are on the shelf?
w10_T4_002173: Bruno had 196 crates in the barn and sold 104 of them at the auction. His neighbour Elsa, who owns far fewer crates than Bruno, borrowed 43 more for her own harvest. Every crate left in the barn holds 5 sacks. Each sack contains 6 nets, and every net holds 3 bulbs of garlic. The barn is 40 metres long, and the farm has been in the family for a dozen generations. How many bulbs of garlic are in the barn?
w10_T4_002177: On Monday morning Ilse counted 237 pallets in the warehouse, and a delivery added 22 more before lunch. Every pallet carries 4 crates. In the afternoon her colleague Ben, who had handled fewer pallets than Ilse, added 48 loose crates from his own bay. Each crate holds 9 boxes, and every box is packed with 2 sleeves. In the evening the team confirmed that each sleeve contains 9 sachets. How many sachets are in the warehouse?
w10_T4_002185: Marisol filled 53 boxes, and each box held 9 packets of dried apricots. Every packet contains 3 handfuls. A supplier added 41 loose handfuls to the store. A wholesaler bought 1036 handfuls, and her partner Ivo, who packed fewer boxes than Marisol, took another 241 handfuls for his own shop. Each handful that remains is repacked into 8 small bags. The pair have worked together for a dozen years. How many small bags does the repacking produce?
w10_T4_002186: In the morning a cafe set out 14 cake stands, and each stand held 4 slices. At midday the slices were shared equally between 4 counters, and the window counter took the first share. During the afternoon 9 slices were sold from the window counter. In the evening the kitchen brought out 66 more slices for that same counter. The cafe times its bakes in minutes rather than hours. How many slices are on the window counter?
w10_T4_002188: A publisher printed 169 bundles, and each bundle was split into 2 stacks. Every stack holds 8 folders, and each folder contains 8 leaflets. A distributor took 9301 leaflets away for a mailing. A late print run added 8 more leaflets to the store. Each leaflet still in the store is folded to make 5 separate panels. How many panels are there in the store's leaflets?
